headword: {宿泊施設|しゅくはくしせつ}

definitions.gloss: lodging facilities; accommodation; place to stay
definitions.explanation: Any facility that provides overnight accommodation for guests, including hotels, ryokan, hostels, minshuku, and other types of lodging.

examples.japanese: {宿泊施設|しゅくはくしせつ}を{予約|よやく}する。
この{地域|ちいき}には{宿泊施設|しゅくはくしせつ}が{少|すく}ない。
examples.english: There are few lodging facilities in this area.

examples.japanese: {観光客|かんこうきゃく}の{増加|ぞうか}に{伴|ともな}い、{新|あたら}しい{宿泊施設|しゅくはくしせつ}が{次々|つぎつぎ}と{建|た}てられている。
examples.english: With the increase in tourists, new lodging facilities are being built one after another.

notes:
USAGE:
A general term encompassing all types of lodging. Common in tourism, government, and business contexts. Japan offers diverse accommodation types including ホテル (hotel), {旅館|りょかん} (traditional Japanese inn), {民宿|みんしゅく} (guesthouse), ペンション (pension), and カプセルホテル (capsule hotel).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宿泊施設|しゅくはくしせつ}を{探|さが}す (to look for lodging)
- {宿泊施設|しゅくはくしせつ}を{予約|よやく}する (to book accommodation)
- {宿泊施設|しゅくはくしせつ}の{確保|かくほ} (securing accommodation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {宿|やど}: lodging, inn — a simpler, more everyday word
- {旅館|りょかん}: traditional Japanese inn — a specific type of accommodation
